intro: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade is a night elf scout stationed along the main road of Darkshore, just west of the ancient ruins of Ameth'Aran. Tasked with patrolling the troubled coastal wilderness, she directs travelers and recruits aid to investigate the restless spirits haunting the shattered elven settlements nearby.

p: Standing sentinel along the overgrown highway of Darkshore, Tysha Moonblade keeps a vigilant eye over an increasingly unstable land. Directly to her east lie the haunted remnants of Ameth'Aran, where cursed Highborne ghosts and malevolent banshees linger among ancient stone pillars. Recognizing that Auberdine's limited defenses are stretched thin by threats across the coast, Tysha enlists capable adventurers passing by to uncover the history behind Ameth'Aran's tragic fall and put down the restless dead.
